A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CoRNStack dataset, CodeRankEmbed retriever, and CodeRankLLM reranker. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and complete Appendix A.1–A.7 support reliable comparison, including matching relocated material.

before.justification: v1 reports original dataset-quality assessments, retrieval and reranking experiments, SWE-Bench-Lite localization results, and additional encoder, training-data, and teacher–student experiments in the appendix.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical studies, including the appendix experiments, and reports revised file-localization results in Table 6.

M1.justification: The dual consistency filtering, curriculum-based hard-negative sampling, bi-encoder retriever, and teacher-supervised listwise reranker are unchanged. Sections 2–3 and Appendix A.7 retain the same objectives, inference procedures, and augmentation.

E1.justification: Training languages, datasets, and evaluation tasks are retained, including CodeSearchNet, AdvTest, CoIR, and SWE-Bench-Lite localization. The revised localization sample selection concerns the protocol within an existing task.

E2.justification: Table 3 removes E5-Base from the CodeSearchNet and AdvTest comparison. E5-Base remains in the CoIR and localization comparisons; the other comparator sets, including the appendix CodeT5+ variants and teacher–student comparison, are retained.

E3.justification: Section 4.3.1 in v1 describes the 300-problem SWE-Bench-Lite set without an eligibility restriction; v3 specifies retaining 274 cases whose patches modify existing functions or classes, excluding cases introducing new functions or import statements. Together with revised file-level scores, this changes the reported evaluation sample, without establishing that experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: The filtering, hard-negative, and curriculum ablations are retained unchanged. Figure 2's localization cases and the appendix analyses of topic diversity, encoder choice, data quality and scale, and teacher–student performance were already present in v1.

E5.justification: Both versions describe the same dataset-correctness evaluation using 10,000 sampled pairs per dataset and three seeds, reporting mean correctness. No repeated-run information, confidence intervals, variance estimates, or significance tests are added or revised.

E6.justification: File-localization scores change for the retriever rows in v1 Table 7 versus v3 Table 6. For example, CodeRankEmbed's top-1/2/3 scores change from 47.3/62.7/70.0 to 51.8/68.6/76.6, consistent with changing the denominator from 300 to 274 rather than improved model performance. Function-level and other retained results are unchanged; E5-Base's CodeSearchNet/AdvTest entries are removed.

T1.justification: The similarity and filtering definitions, negative-sampling distribution, InfoNCE objective in Equation 1, and language-model objective in Equation 2 are unchanged. Neither version adds distinct theoretical results or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about high-quality contrastive data, strong retrieval with a smaller encoder, LLM code reranking, and improved function localization. The revised title makes the existing retrieval-and-reranking scope explicit.

C2.justification: v3 removes the explicit limitation that practical benefits were demonstrated only for function localization, with downstream code repair unevaluated because of GPT-4o API costs. No repair results are added. The semantic-overlap and execution-based validation caveats remain in shortened form.

D1.justification: v3 adds reproducibility information identifying the 274 retained SWE-Bench-Lite cases through explicit patch-eligibility criteria. Training hyperparameters, hardware, implementation package, appendix augmentation details, and code/data/model access information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The introduction and references add CRANE, IterGen, SynCode, and the study of watermarking robustness for LLM-generated code. These are limited citation additions; the positioning relative to contrastive code retrieval and listwise reranking remains unchanged.

P1.justification: The title, publication header, and an author affiliation are updated. Retrieval-results prose and the localization dataset description are revised, limitations are shortened, and appendix model labels are standardized. Most prose and the section hierarchy remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The detailed CoIR table moves from v1 Table 4 in the main text to v3 Table 8 in the appendix, while Table 3 gains a CoIR-average column and loses the E5-Base row. The ablation table and end matter shift position, with associated renumbering and reflow. All three figures are unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 makes the localization evaluation clearer by specifying the 274 eligible cases and revising retriever file-level percentages consistently with that denominator. This improves reporting and comparability without establishing stronger model performance. Removing the explicit untested-code-repair caveat and E5-Base's CodeSearchNet/AdvTest results reduces some transparency, but the clearer evaluation accounting provides a limited net gain.
